mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates and stimulates corporate investment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger recession fears and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) create a temporary equity valuation boost due to delayed monetary tightening expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% AND FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL 12-month change > 3.0%) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) indicates imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days during late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL_12m_change > 3.0 AND UNRATE < 3.5, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly non-farm payroll growth exceeding 100,000 persons indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 100000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly industrial production declines below 100 (index 2017=100) signal manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts below 1300 thousand units and industrial production below 100 indicate broad-based economic deceleration, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days through reduced consumer and business confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1300 AND INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer credit expansion (RSAFS 12-month change > 5.0%) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) fuels spending and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days during credit-driven growth regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS_12m_change > 5.0 AND FEDFUNDS < 2.5, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
